annotation_scope: Codex automated review of all 180 native-rate frames, 480.000–485.967 seconds: jumping exchange, diving retrieval, floor-level/post-point context and another exchange after a wide-to-wide broadcast edit at frame 117. Partial context of two points, not one uninterrupted fixed-camera rally. Labels frozen before reading per-frame predictions or benchmark results for this new packet. Earlier sparse model previews and one existing sparse label had been seen; this is not blind, independent or held-out truth. Same previously seen match/camera; upstream training overlap unknown. Repeated broadcast frames are correlated.
coordinate_method: Visually selected raw source components in full-frame temporal sheets and 4x local crops. Center refinement uses positive mean-RGB difference >30 against raw frame 0 (first scene) or 117 (second), current brightness >125, connected-component area <=100, width <=15, height <=24 in manually chosen local regions. Components were individually chosen after raw-crop inspection. Ambiguous line/official/racket overlaps remain uncertain. No evaluated model positions or interpolated coordinates supplied labels.

annotation_scene_boundaries.reason: Independent full-source inspection: score/player positions jump while view remains wide court.
